forkChangesPreserved: T3 Pretty continues to omit picker-side base64 encoding so the picker resolves promptly, preparing thumbnails can be shown, and the composer does not appear stuck while images are encoded. Image bytes continue to be read explicitly from each asset URI afterward.
upstreamChangesIntegrated: Added the parent's foreground-handoff guard around the image-library picker, including guaranteed cleanup in a finally block, preventing Android background lifecycle events during picker activity from triggering restarts.

upstreamChangesOmitted.change: The parent picker options request `base64: true`.
upstreamChangesOmitted.reason: Picker-side encoding conflicts with T3 Pretty's deliberate progress and responsiveness fix by delaying picker completion until all assets are encoded. The existing post-pick `File(asset.uri).base64()` path still creates the required payload, so omitting this option does not lose attachment data.
